## Creating it

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasChartElementBase(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

### struct `ChartAxisTicks`

The ticks of one axis: every multiple of a whole step (1, 2, 2.5 or 5 x 10^n) between lo and hi, as a person would mark a ruler - 0, 20, 40 ... 140, never 0, 24.85, 49.7. Labels drop the decimals the step does not need and switch to K or M once the largest tick reaches ten thousand or ten million, so one axis never mixes "500" and "1K".

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `step` | `double step = 0.0` | 0 when lo..hi is empty |
| `values` | `std::vector<double> values` | ascending, all inside lo..hi |
| `decimals` | `int decimals = 0` | what the labels show after the point |
| `unitDivisor` | `double unitDivisor = 1.0` | 1, 1e3 or 1e6 |
| `unitSuffix` | `std::string unitSuffix` | "", "K" or "M" |
